title: A remedy or advice line that claims an effect cites the run that measured it
why: Incident: 10:55 CST Nov 12 advice "kill the pid whose grandparent is init and the tree ends" was disproved by runner 10's 11:14 CST kill of pid 32666 (lane stranded-jobs).
source: coordinator 13:02 CST Nov 12, from lane stranded-jobs
note: A remedy or advice line that claims an effect ("ends the tree", "stops the job") cites the run that measured it or says "unmeasured". Cost: a text scan of changed decision and remedy lines at lane lint; no new process. Overlap checked 13:07 CST: pass-claim-cites-verdict covers pass claims ("passed", "green") and msg-claims-vs-git covers lane and step claims; neither covers effect claims in remedy lines, so this stays its own step.
